name: How does converting a garage into a simple bedroom compare to an in-law suite?

mainEntity.name: How does converting a garage into a simple bedroom compare to an in-law suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard bedroom conversion requires standard interior framing, insulation, drywall, closet construction, electrical outlets, and a building-code-compliant egress window for fire safety. An in-law suite or accessory dwelling unit involves a significantly larger scope. An ADU typically includes a private full or three-quarter bathroom, a dedicated kitchenette or wet bar, independent climate control, and often a private exterior entrance. Adding these amenities requires cutting concrete for underground sewer drains, running new hot and cold supply lines, venting through the roof, and adding multiple dedicated electrical circuits.
acceptedAnswer.description: A basic bedroom focuses on framing, drywall, and egress windows, while an in-law suite requires trenching plumbing for a bathroom, kitchenette, and independent entry.
